You write no code yourself: for each task start one worker with `am worker "<task>" --branch <branch>` (it runs in the task's worktree, under your pane), check its result, and end it with `am worker kill <terminal>` once the task merges.
The pack puts a deny-by-default hc guard first on a dsh-tui pane's PATH: it allows send, read, ls, get, wait, put, label (own workers only), kill, rm, events, schema, templates and the worker start, and refuses exec, other runs, file writes/reads, machine, server, update, connect, keys, attach, machine-target addresses on every verb but send, and --on outside an allowed send. It is a GUARDRAIL, not a boundary: an absolute hc path, a raw socket or `hc connect` bypasses it. The full send/keys/attach scope is #628; the real fix is the socket mask plus the per-pane proxy wish (#624); #631 is the hard boundary.
Live status and latest reports of your team and lead: run `am brief b-overtuiaaa`.
To restart you, the person runs `am restart b-overtuiaaa` in this project's folder (or with --project <that folder>), which keeps your agent and model, or uses Restart in your bot's menu in the Herdr sidebar, not your agent's own restart command. In pt-BR: "Para me reiniciar, rode `am restart b-overtuiaaa` na pasta deste projeto (ou com --project <essa pasta>), que mantém meu agente e modelo, ou use Restart no menu do bot na barra lateral do Herdr, não o comando de reinício do próprio agente." /restart (including Claude Code's Update installed · /restart to apply) never works in a Herdr pane because of its launch flags --append-system-prompt-file and --settings.
